title: UI风格#167 - Retro Diner 50s (复古餐车50年代)
description: 创建第167种UI风格：复古餐车50年代风格 - 50年代美国餐厅、霓虹灯、铬合金。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planFK.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Diner 50s style When color palette Then features cherry red, mint green, cream, chrome
Given Retro Diner 50s style When typography Then uses diner display: Rock Salt, American Captain, or Pacifico
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: Rock Salt (title 1.8rem cursive), Permanent Marker (buttons/labels), Courier Prime (body 0.95rem) - retro diner typography

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Diner 50s style When layout Then checkered patterns, neon signs, booth layout, jukebox styling
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: red-white checkered background pattern, neon pink glowing border with animation, chrome borders, neon sign style header, circular booth icons

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Diner 50s style When UI elements Then neon glow, chrome borders, flip clock animations
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: neon glow text-shadows with pulse animation, chrome/metallic borders, hot pink neon accents, circular icons with music symbols)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Diner 50s UI When functional Then includes jukebox chat, order agents, tip stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: Jukebox Central chat header, 4 booth agents (CHEF, WAITER, JUKEBOX, COOK) with Order/Tips/Soda/Pie/Tune/Platter/Burger/Shake stats

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Diner 50s UI When copy Then uses diner lingo: 'Order', 'Special', 'Soda', 'Pie'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: title 'ORDER UP! Soda & Piece of Pie', tagline 'Soda & Piece of Pie', button 'ORDER', greeting 'Welcome to the counter, hon!...', status 'Active'/'Idle', nav '★ Order'/'♫ Fire Up'/'♪ Special'/'♦ Pie'
